data.text: Code review of PR #11 (medium): verdict CHANGES. 10 findings, 3 correctness: (1) SortEvents groups by raw subject id, not alias-resolved, so backdated alias events still reorder (state.go:397); (2) ByDecision lane accepts any by_decision without checking the decision is decided/applying and blocks the task (lanes.go:115); (3) --fragment leaks :root/heading/link styles and fixed element ids into the host page (mapview.go:80). Plus: orphan-step flags routing/conflict events (conflict.go:281); ProjectName ignores configured name (projections.go:255); 3 git subprocesses per command (cli.go:309); double SortEvents (conflict.go:278); misleading contract-version error (write.go:870); freeze action for pathless contracts (actions.go:65); brief path hard-coded 3x (views.go:497). Fix all, or answer why not.
